items.title: Being syntomic is syntomic local on the source
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file descent.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma asserts that syntomicity is syntomic local on the source (statement lines 7118-7122). The proof assembles the four clauses of the chapter's general criterion for locality on the source, naming each ingredient: the characterisation of syntomic morphisms (Zariski local on source and target), preservation under precomposition by a syntomic morphism, and the permanence statement that supplies clause (4) (proof lines 7124-7129). The level is H2: the card is short, but the proof states exactly which ingredients realise the four clauses rather than merely invoking the criterion.
